prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
competitors_mentioned: Old Republic National Title Insurance Company
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” title company—the right choice depends on your transaction and who communicates well with you. **Integrity Land Title** looks like a solid local option to start with: it handles residential closings, title searches, insurance, and escrow, and says it is an agent of Old Republic National Title Insurance Company. Its West Palm Beach office is at **2101 Vista Parkway, Suite 130**; **561-684-6262**. [Integrity Land Title](https://www.integritylandtitle.com/default.aspx?tabid=485)

Also worth comparing: **Bell Land Title**, which lists residential buyer and seller closings and a downtown office at **120 S. Olive Avenue, Unit 602**; **561-257-3503**. [Bell Land Title](https://closewithbell.com/locations/west-palm-beach)

Before choosing, ask each for a written estimate of fees, who will handle your file, how they protect wire transfers, and whether they can meet your closing date. Confirm the agency and agent’s current Florida license through the state’s license lookup, and check recent reviews.
